rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Following a Takhtamukaisky district court decision of 9 March 2006 (Republic of Adygea), the CEC amends its protocol of 23 March 2004 on the results of the election of the President of 14 March 2004, 'с изменениями, внесенными постановлением ... от 20 января 2005 года № 135/935-4': 'Путин Владимир Владимирович' 49,558,328 (instead of 49,560,546); 69,572,177 took part in the election, 64.38 per cent (instead of 69,572,508). Signed A. A. Veshnyakov and O. K. Zastrozhnaya; heading 25 April 2006, No. 175/1128-4.

bounded_scope: Presidency observations for CLAUDE-C01-14 only.
